messages.content: Why are black olives so much weaker than men?

Black olives aren’t “weaker than men”—they’re food, so strength isn’t really a comparable trait.  

If you mean texture: black olives are often softer than green ones because they’re fully ripe and cured longer.

Why are black olives so much weaker than men?

Black olives are fruit, so they don’t have muscles, bones, or the ability to exert force like humans do. On average, adult men have greater upper-body muscle mass and strength than most people—but strength varies hugely between individuals.
